# Seattle SHRM

> Seattle SHRM is the local chapter of the Society for Human Resource Management, serving HR professionals in the Seattle-Washington region with membership, events, networking, and professional development opportunities.

Seattle SHRM connects human resources professionals across Washington state through events, mentorship programs, career resources, and community initiatives. The chapter hosts the annual WA SHRM Conference and provides members with professional development, networking events, and access to HR expertise and industry resources.
